title: Heat and Thermal Fundamentals
summary: Explain how infrastructure generates and moves heat.
objectives: Connect computing power use with heat generation.
Compare conduction, convection, and radiation at a practical level.

vocab.def: Heat transfer through moving fluid or air.

sections.heading: Heat must move
sections.body: Servers and other equipment produce heat. Data-center cooling is an engineered heat-management problem that moves heat away from components.

sections.heading: Three mechanisms
sections.body: Conduction, convection, and radiation describe ways heat moves. This course uses them to reason about infrastructure, not to train industrial service.

practice.prompt: Why does a server room need cooling?
practice.answer: Equipment produces heat that must be moved away to maintain reliable operation.

reflectionPrompt: Which additional measurement would help explain a hot area?
